+ Same Passport screens and Homegate methods as suite apps.
+ The app gets a Session for its own scope only. It never sees the key or the SSO account.
+ No COOP hop: Passport can message the app tab and close the pop-up itself.
+ Users can pick their own Passport instance in the SDK.
+ The same SDK button, with Accounts left out.
− No single sign-on: each external app asks for its own approval (one click when signed in to
− Each app's grant needs your key, not a child grant. Grant-only identities need an SSO sign-in or
− The app handles the pop-up, the relay and the Session. The SDK does this.
